instruction: How many likes did all Venmo transactions, I received this year, have in total?

steps.code:
venmo_password = [p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "venmo"][0]
login_result = apis.venmo.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
print(login_result)

from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
print(now)
current_year = now.year
print(current_year)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]
page_index = 0
received_transactions = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at='2023-01-01',
        max_created_at='2023-12-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    received_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(received_transactions))

total_likes = sum(t.get("like_count", 0) for t in received_transactions)
print(total_likes)

receivers = set(t["receiver"]["email"] for t in received_transactions)
print(receivers)
